sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
मया प्रसन्नेन तवार्जुनेदं
रूपं परं दर्शितमात्मयोगात् ।
तेजोमयं विश्वमनन्तमाद्यं
यन्मे त्वदन्येन न दृष्टपूर्वम् ॥ ११-४७॥
iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
mayā prasannena tavārjunedaṃ
rūpaṃ paraṃ darśitamātmayogāt
tejomayaṃ viśvamanantamādyaṃ
yanme tvadanyena na dṛṣṭapūrvam 11-47
translation: Blessed Lord said: Graciously by Me, O Arjuna, this Supreme-Form has been shown to you by My own YOGA-power — Full of splendour, Primeval, Infinite, this Universal-Form of Mine has never been seen by any other than yourself .
